rules.notes: Nil on delivery. Verified 2026-09-08 against https://zerodha.com/charges.

NSE cash market transaction charge, revised to 0.0030699% (Rs 306.99 each side per crore) with effect from 2026-03-01 (NSE circular NSE/FA/73061 of 2026-02-27). The preceding card carries 0.00297%, which is what applied from 2024-10-01 until then (NSE/FA/64232). The same circular cut the separate IPFT contribution to Rs 0.01 per crore, which this card carries on its own IPFT line at 0.0000001%.

NSE Investor Protection Fund Trust, Rs 0.01 per crore of traded value from 2026-03-01, a separate contribution beside the transaction charge (NSE circular NSE/FA/73061 of 2026-02-27); Rs 10 per crore applied from 2023-04-01 until 2026-02-28 (NSE/FA/56129). Read 2026-10-30; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md rows 14 and N3 (W-185).
Rs 13.50 plus GST per scrip per day, once however many sells. Verified 2026-09-08 against https://zerodha.com/charges.
